finding: Investigated same-mesh positive control for Method C (Package 83). Proved that authentic Abaqus restart file (.res) is absent on cluster scratch and locally because *RESTART, WRITE was omitted from Package 76 forward deck. Furthermore, verified that donor ODB fieldOutputs['U'] contains only 2 displacement components (DOF 1 and 2), with DOF 3 not exported to nodal fields. Under frozen production UEL f42_mixed_uel.for, internal UEL history SVARS(5..8) cannot be initialized via input deck keywords without a .res restart database. Pursuant to mandatory prompt directive, activated explicit NO-SUBMIT recovery branch and withheld Package 83 submission. Formulated the exact forward restart unblocking protocol (forward execution up to u_top = 0.00254 mm with *RESTART, WRITE and 3-DOF nodal outputs) to enable genuine same-mesh positive control.
